messages:
sam: Quick q for the team  adding an inline help panel + keyboard shortcut cheat-sheet to the Prompt Evals scorecard. Link to proto: https://files.redwood/s/help-panel-proto. Need copy and a11y checks. Thoughts?

elaine: Love the idea of a collapsible help rail. UX nit: keep it collapsed by default on small screens. The cheat-sheet should show shorthand keys (A = Approve, R = Mark regression) and a short explanation line for each.

jon: Implementation notes: the help rail can be lazy-loaded. Shortcut handler should only register when scorecard is focused to avoid global shortcut conflicts. Also prefer a global toggle in settings for power users.

aria: A11y checklist for the new panel:
- Panel must have role="complementary" and aria-label="Scorecard help"
- Ensure keyboard trap is NOT created when panel opens; focus should land on panel heading and be reversible with Escape
- Shortcut descriptions must be readable by screen readers and included in an offscreen list for SR users (aria-hidden=false)
- Provide aria-describedby on the Approve button referencing the shortcut text: "Approve (A)"
- Collapsed state should announce "Help panel collapsed" via aria-live when toggled

maya: From UXR sessions users liked in-context help that shows shortcuts on first visit. Proposal: show a one-time tooltip pointing to the help icon: "Keyboard shortcuts & tips" with a link to permanently enable the rail.

sam: Decisions so far:
- Add collapsible help rail on scorecard, collapsed by default on mobile
- Show compact cheat-sheet: list of shortcuts + one-line descriptions
- Register shortcuts only when scorecard focused; add settings toggle for always-on
- Accessibility: aria labels, SR-visible shortcut list, aria-live announcements for panel toggle

elaine: I'll update Figma with the rail and a compact cheat-sheet layout + mobile collapsed states. Also will add microcopy for the help icon tooltip: "Keyboard shortcuts & quick tips". ETA: EOD.

jon: I'll spike the focus-scoped shortcut registration and the lazy rail. Will also wire the aria-live messages. ETA: tomorrow morning.

aria: I'll draft a short a11y test script (focus flow, SR reading of shortcuts, toggle announcements) and run it once mocks are up.

files-bot: uploaded help-panel-proto.png and shortcut-cheatsheet.md (https://files.redwood/s/help-panel-proto)

sam: Thanks team ":thumbsup:". Action owners: @elaine mocks, @jon spike, @aria a11y tests. Ping here if anything blocks before sprint planning.
